_meta.description: D6 fixtures for ag2 / gen-ui-declarative (A2UI Dynamic Schema)
_meta._note: Option A (JS-runtime-injected A2UI). Mirrors langgraph-python gen-ui-declarative.json 1:1 (same 4 sales-context pills, same render_a2ui component trees). ag2 backend is the dedicated a2ui_dynamic.py agent mounted at /declarative-gen-ui (the route points HttpAgent at ${AGENT_URL}/declarative-gen-ui/, injectA2UITool:true default). Two-stage fixture pattern: (1) outer agent emits no-arg generate_a2ui toolcall (matched by userMessage+context=ag2); (2) CopilotKit JS middleware intercepts, drives secondary render_a2ui LLM pass (matched by userMessage+toolName=render_a2ui) and synthesizes the tool result + fires RUN_FINISHED. The outer generate_a2ui handler takes NO arguments.
